answer: Commit the hash of the work, wait one block, reveal the text. A skipped reveal drops the receipt; a duplicate reveal forfeits the stake. Auditors come from a rotating pool seeded per epoch, never a panel an operator can pre-book. A farm copying one answer across 400 identities forfeits 400 stakes at the first duplicate, and the vine of clones never reaches the summit of a payout. The rule is crystal: hash first, text second, stake gone on a copy.
